```{r}
library(astsa)
library(xts)
#View(djia)
```

$$\log (1+r_t) \approx  r_t $$
```{r}
djia_return = diff(log(djia$Close))[-1]
djia_return
par(mfrow= c(2,1))
plot((djia$Close), col = 4)
plot(djia_return, col = 4)



```



$$ r_t = \frac{x_t - x_{t-1}}{x_{t-1}}$$

```{r}
 rt_direct = diff(djia$Close)/lag(djia$Close, -1)
cbind(rt_direct, djia_return)
plot(rt_direct)


#The Lag is similar to X_t-1 
```




```{R}


difference <- rt_direct - djia_return 
difference <- na.omit(difference)
mean(difference)


```
We can perform $\chi^2 -$ test and $t-$ test to compare the standard deviation and mean.
